description: The fall of Apophis leaves a power vacuum as Anubis begins moving back into Goa’uld politics. SG-1 faces new threats to Earth and its allies while Daniel’s pursuit of the Goa’uld struggle culminates in a sacrifice that changes the team.

s05e01.description: SG-1, Jacob and Apophis are stranded in another galaxy as a Replicator-controlled ship closes in, while Teal’c returns home under enemy control.

s05e02.description: Bra’tac uses an ancient Jaffa ritual to break Apophis’s conditioning of Teal’c, forcing him to confront the beliefs that once defined his life.

s05e03.description: Carter is visited by an ascended alien who followed her home and claims his people will destroy him if he interferes with human affairs.

s05e04.description: O’Neill is trapped behind enemy lines with a man none of SG-1 remembers, while the others discover their memories have been deliberately altered.

s05e05.description: A damaged Stargate wormhole destabilizes a planet’s sun, leaving SG-1 to persuade a deeply religious society to accept help from the Asgard.

s05e06.description: Cassandra reaches adolescence and develops dangerous physical changes linked to the Goa’uld experiments performed on her as a child.

s05e07.description: Daniel returns to the Unas world after learning his friend Chaka has been captured and sold into slavery.

s05e08.description: SG-1 and a Russian team enter an ancient ziggurat to investigate missing soldiers and awaken a dangerous Goa’uld presence.

s05e09.description: The Tollan offer Earth advanced technology just as their relationship with the Goa’uld changes in ways SG-1 does not trust.

s05e10.description: Earth re-encounters the Aschen and begins negotiating an alliance, while SG-1 tries to determine whether this is the future Daniel once warned them about.

s05e11.description: Carter is kidnapped by a dying businessman who believes a Goa’uld symbiote can cure him, drawing the NID into a dangerous private experiment.

s05e12.description: An alien with knowledge of the Stargate inspires a television producer to create a suspiciously familiar science-fiction series.

s05e13.description: Young recruits training for future SG teams face a final exercise that becomes indistinguishable from a real emergency.

s05e14.description: Teal’c becomes trapped inside the Stargate’s buffer after a malfunction, giving the SGC only hours to recover his pattern before the gate is used again.

s05e15.description: Daniel infiltrates a secret meeting of Goa’uld System Lords while the Tok’ra prepare a strike that could reshape the balance of power.

s05e16.description: Daniel’s mission among the System Lords collides with Osiris and the return of Anubis, while the Tok’ra base comes under attack.

s05e17.description: An asteroid on a collision course with Earth turns out to contain a material that prevents the Stargate from offering an easy solution.

s05e18.description: A charismatic Jaffa leader unites rebels against the Goa’uld, but Teal’c begins to question both his methods and the source of his apparent invincibility.

s05e19.description: SG-1 discovers a young android whose creation is tied to the origins of the Replicators and whose loneliness may unleash them again.

s05e20.description: SG-1 must repair an alien defensive device after learning that a covert NID mission disabled the weapon that once protected an allied world.

s05e21.description: After absorbing a lethal dose of radiation to save others, Daniel faces death and an offer from Oma Desala to leave human existence behind.

s05e22.description: The Asgard ask SG-1 to protect a scientist working on a decisive anti-Replicator weapon as Anubis’s forces close in.
